q1.question: How does the payment process work?
q1.answer: Click 'Pay via PayOS' button, complete payment in the embedded PayOS window, and your Premium subscription will be activated automatically.

q2.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
q2.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. Your premium features will remain active until the end of your current billing period.

q3.question: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
q3.answer: Your data is always safe. If you exceed the limits of your new plan, you'll need to delete some content or upgrade again to access everything.
